judgment.notes: The time partial is completely typed on the positive-time domain with componentwise real derivatives and an explicit zero fallback. This is a total convention, not an assumption of differentiability. On smooth input it coincides with the original time derivative. The local zero extensions used for sources are declared in R001 and leave this global domain unchanged.

Defines precisely the time derivative of D001 on the same positive-time domain, componentwise with its total convention. D001 is declared as its sole definition dependency; no scalar multiplier regularity or second-derivative identity is assumed in the definition.

The family of first spatial coordinate partials has explicit index range 1,…,n, spatial/time arguments and vector codomain. The fixed-index abbreviation has one meaning. The same total derivative convention as D001 makes it well-defined without importing smoothness; H001/H002 remain hypotheses rather than properties of this definition.

Compared the complete original conditions and approved support interpretation with spec.full_target, all six spec/graph H records, and contextual P. Positive integer dimensions are H001 (not hidden parameter refinements); joint smoothness, unit q, sphere constraint, pointwise existential normal scalar with no regularity, and locally time-uniform common compact support are faithfully retained as H002–H006. H003 is explicitly retained but unused. The energy uses the unhalved Euclidean/Frobenius square and Lebesgue volume. Integrability, differentiability and zero derivative are asserted for every positive time, with no time-zero assertion; constancy is the supplied consequence. The candidate keeps tangency and optional explicit scalar calculation, common compact support, dominated difference quotients, coordinate FTC/Fubini integration by parts, and cancellation. Edge inspection includes n=m=1, empty spatial support, singleton constancy interval, arbitrary pointwise scalar witnesses, and positive-time localization; no target drift found. This is global A0/A5/route review, not certification of individual R bodies or controller behavioral checks.
